_rule: Every output the v2.1 fit saves, declared 2026-10-14 before any block is fitted (readiness L9). Written by atlas_block_v21.write_block per block and by run_v21.sh at the end. Nothing else is produced by the fit; anything derived later is computed from these.

columns.cell: cell-type name verbatim (Loyfer and Moss names; final_samples_v21.csv)
columns.n_obs: observations entering this cell and CpG; 0 = NOT MEASURED (every other column NaN)
columns.mu: posterior mean of the cell's methylation at this CpG
columns.donor_sd: posterior mean of the healthy donor-to-donor spread

block_NNNNN_draws.npz.draws: K = 100 thinned posterior draws of mu, float16, shape (K, cells, CpGs); NaN where NOT MEASURED
block_NNNNN_draws.npz.sd_draws: the same 100 draws of the donor spread
block_NNNNN_draws.npz.chain: the chain (0-3) of each saved draw
block_NNNNN_draws.npz.cells: cell names, in the array order
block_NNNNN_draws.npz.cpg: CpG ids, in the array order

block_NNNNN_prior.parquet.nu: posterior mean of the shared logit mean across cells
block_NNNNN_prior.parquet.tau: posterior mean of the across-cell spread

per_run.stageB_v21_summary.json: blocks, loci, divergences, worst R-hat and ESS, per-cell measured fraction, v2's distinctness gate
per_run.distinctness_v21.csv: every cell pair's mean |difference| and r on shared measured CpGs

fixed_inputs_saved_with_the_release.transfer_v21_final.json: the bounded transfer (42 knots), its measured cell scatter, every array laboratory's offset d. Laboratory terms are FIXED per source, not per site (decision 16 tested and not adopted, labterms_synthetic_v21.py)
fixed_inputs_saved_with_the_release.final_samples_v21.csv: every sample, its cell and source
fixed_inputs_saved_with_the_release.seeds: 1000 + block, blocks = np.array_split of the sorted locus list into 700

derived_after_the_fit_not_saved_by_it.posterior_predictive: for any sample, draws of its expected reading follow from the saved mu and donor-spread draws and the fixed terms, so they are computed after the fit from these files rather than stored
